common.appSubtitle: A macOS battery helper built on batt

onboarding.intro: A desktop battery manager built around batt: a clearer dashboard, a friendlier setup flow, and a macOS experience that feels ready for daily use and distribution.
onboarding.bullet2: Set default charging strategy and launch at login
onboarding.bullet3: Guide users into the Dashboard and tray workflow
onboarding.title: First-launch setup
onboarding.compatUnsupported: This device is not an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS, so batt cannot work properly.
onboarding.compatMissing: batt was not detected. Please install the batt CLI first.
onboarding.compatDaemon: batt was detected, but the daemon is not ready yet.
onboarding.compatReady: Environment check passed. You can continue with the initial setup.
onboarding.newVersion: A new version is available: current {{current}}, latest {{latest}}.
onboarding.openRelease: Open release page to update batt
onboarding.footer: batt Core installation and upgrades follow the official recommendation: script installs use the official installer, Homebrew installs use Homebrew upgrade and then reinstall the daemon.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: See charge, power source, health, and current strategy in one place.
dashboard.empty: No status is available yet. Finish batt installation or refresh again.
dashboard.presetHint: Settings are written to batt immediately and trigger an instant refresh.

charging.title: Charging
charging.subtitle: Manage charge limit, lower limit delta, adapter control, and forced discharge.
charging.empty: batt is not connected, so charging strategy cannot be changed.
charging.chargeLimitHint: For mostly-plugged-in usage, 70–80% is usually recommended.
charging.adapterHint: Useful when you want to stay plugged in but still discharge the battery.
charging.forceDischargeConfirm: Disabling the adapter will switch the Mac to battery power. Continue?

health.title: Health
health.subtitle: Understand current battery health, cycle count, and power performance.
health.tip1: For mostly-plugged-in usage, keep the upper limit around 70–80%.
health.tip2: If you need maximum runtime, temporarily switch to 90–100%.
health.tip3: Run a calibration every few months to stabilize readings.
health.advicePending: Once batt telemetry is available, health advice will appear here.
health.adviceExcellent: Battery health looks excellent. You can keep a daily limit around 70–80%.
health.adviceGood: Overall health looks good. Consider regular calibration and avoid long periods at full charge in high temperatures.
health.adviceFair: Battery health has declined noticeably. Consider reducing full-charge dwell time and reviewing cycle count and temperature behavior.

calibration.title: Calibration
calibration.subtitle: Manage batt auto-calibration flow and schedule visually.
calibration.riskHint: Risk note: keep power connected during calibration when possible. Closing the lid may trigger sleep, and clamshell mode should stay open.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage theme, language, launch behavior, and quick presets.
settings.coreFooter: Version checks and updates are supported now. Script installs use the official install script; Homebrew installs run `brew update && brew upgrade batt` and then reinstall the daemon.
